WITH matched_scans AS (
  SELECT 
    scans.zoneref,
    sites.riskeval,
    scans.pressratio
  FROM scans
  INNER JOIN sites ON scans.zoneref = sites.zoneregistry
),
grouped AS (
  SELECT 
    zoneref,
    riskeval,
    AVG(pressratio) AS avg_compression_ratio,
    COUNT(*) AS num_scans
  FROM matched_scans
  GROUP BY zoneref, riskeval
)
SELECT 
  zoneref,
  riskeval,
  avg_compression_ratio,
  num_scans,
  CAST(num_scans AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM matched_scans) AS share
FROM grouped
ORDER BY share DESC
LIMIT 10;
